name: Kyōtango (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kyōtango city emblem in navy and red: a navy ring crossed by stylised waves, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kyōtango, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 2004.

features.role: Kyōtango city emblem — a navy ring crossed by stylised waves, with a red disc
